notes.title: 20,000 wishlists on Steam!!!
notes.notes:
It’s been 7 days since we announced our game.
The response has exceeded all our expectations, with over 20,000 players already adding it to their Steam wishlists.
We sincerely thank you for your incredible support!

Currently, we're a small two-person team, but we plan to expand our team gradually. Although development may take some time, we promise to deliver beyond your expectations.
We'll continue to share development blogs and videos on Steam News and social media platforms.

Thank you again for your continued support!

notes.title: New survival game DMZ is coming for the genre crown with a unique combat idea
notes.notes:
If you're on the hunt for a new survival game to keep you engaged for weeks on end, you'll want to keep an eye on DMZ: Nuclear Survival. Bringing some big procedurally generated and terraforming ideas to the table, DMZ looks like it could surpass hits like Once Human and Enshrouded. Shaking up the survival genre isn't easy, but with beer-drinking bears and a huge sense of mechanical freedom, DMZ has what it takes.
